booleanTool.title: Mesh boolean
booleanTool.needTwo: This works on two parts of one object. Add a part, negative part or modifier from the object's menu (right-click it, or the ⋯ button in the object list), place it, then come back here.
booleanTool.unionHint: Joins the two into one part.
booleanTool.differenceHint: Cuts the second one out of the first.
booleanTool.intersectionHint: Keeps only where the two overlap.
booleanTool.resultHint: The result takes the first one's place, type and settings. Undo brings both back.
booleanTool.deleteInput: Delete input (also remove the second one)
